summary: Hiker stranded by snowstorm at/near the summit of Pikes Peak; El Paso County Search and Rescue reached the hiker Oct 1, working with Pikes Peak-America's Mountain to get crews to the summit through winter conditions.
responding_agency: El Paso County Search and Rescue; Pikes Peak-America's Mountain
notes: Autoblog article published October 3, 2026 explicitly reports that rescuers reached the hiker on October 1. It links to FOX21 for the rescue report. Injury status and detailed evacuation method are not reported in the accessible account.
